ideas.pitch: A voice-first, vernacular medical triage and preventive care assistant designed specifically for rural healthcare access in Eastern Uttar Pradesh.
ideas.problem_statement: Need for innovative solutions for real-world socio-economic and public health challenges in semi-urban and rural regions.
ideas.title: RuralMed Multilingual Health Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses regional public health needs, earning high marks for problem understanding, practical utility, and social impact as seen in winning community health projects.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and dashboard solution for monitoring real-time power consumption and waste management bins across large university campuses like MMMUT.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation challenge focusing on institutional efficiency, smart campus initiatives, and sustainable resource management.
ideas.title: CampusPulse IoT Energy Grid & Waste Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages live local utility metrics and an interactive dashboard, scoring well on technical implementation and working prototype functionality.

ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer marketplace and route-optimization tool connecting local farmers directly with urban vendors to minimize agricultural supply chain waste.
ideas.problem_statement: Solving agricultural inefficiencies and bridging the gap between rural producers and urban markets.
ideas.title: AgroStream Local Produce & Cold-Chain Logistics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Strong economic utility and clear measurable impact on local farmer livelihoods, matching judge criteria for scalability and practical value.

ideas.pitch: A mobile app utilizing device accelerometers and computer vision to automatically detect road damage and file geotagged municipal repair tickets.
ideas.problem_statement: Urban infrastructure monitoring and citizen-to-government grievance redressal automation.
ideas.title: CivicEye Autonomous Pothole & Road Hazard Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: High practical utility for municipal authorities with a fully demonstrable mobile prototype that scores exceptionally high on functionality and live demo execution.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight cryptographic credential verification system for academic institutions to instantly authenticate degree certificates and transcripts.
ideas.problem_statement: Combating academic credential fraud and securing institutional document verification pipelines.
ideas.title: EduVerify Exam Credential & Certificate Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates robust technical implementation and cryptographic validation, appealing directly to the technical depth and innovation criteria.
